lb-18or.title: Fix 4 clippy warnings
lb-18or.description: cargo clippy reports 4 warnings: (1) collapsible if in store.rs:285, (2) uninlined format arg in main.rs:410, (3) unnecessary map_or in main.rs:625 (use is_some_and), (4) print literal in main.rs:738. Run cargo clippy --fix or apply manually.

lb-4ttg.title: Add push retry logic to unclaim command
lb-4ttg.description: The claim command (main.rs:372-407) has retry-on-push-conflict logic (fetch, check for claim conflict, merge, re-push), but unclaim (main.rs:429) just fails on push error. Add similar retry/merge logic for unclaim so it handles concurrent modifications gracefully.

lb-61mu.title: Fix column alignment mismatch between print_list_header and print_list_row
lb-61mu.description: print_list_header uses {:<12} for STATUS column but print_list_row uses {:<14} because 'open (claimed)' is 14 chars. This causes column misalignment whenever claimed items appear in the output. Fix by making both use {:<14} (or abbreviate the claimed indicator to fit in 12).

lb-7z3a.title: Install bundled Codex skill from setup codex
lb-7z3a.description: Goal: Make lb setup codex install the bundled brite-architect skill automatically when it is missing. Context: setup_codex in src/main.rs already writes .codex/config.toml, hooks.json, and rules/default.rules idempotently. Requirements: resolve CODEX_HOME from env or default to ~/.codex; copy the bundled skill to the Codex skills directory only if brite-architect does not exist; never overwrite an existing skill; print whether the skill was installed or already present. Acceptance: rerunning lb setup codex on an older repo installs the missing skill; rerunning when the skill exists leaves it untouched and reports that it was already installed. Out of scope: force-update or upgrade behavior.

lb-830f.title: Code review findings
lb-830f.description: Collection of issues found during comprehensive code review of the litebrite codebase

lb-94pu.title: Test Codex skill setup behavior
lb-94pu.description: Goal: Add regression coverage for brite-architect installation behavior in lb setup codex. Context: existing setup codex tests live in src/main.rs and validate generated Codex config files. Requirements: cover install-when-missing, no-overwrite-when-present, idempotent rerun output or state, and CODEX_HOME/default home resolution in a temp-safe way. Acceptance: cargo test passes and tests prove an existing skill file is preserved. Out of scope: network installation from GitHub or curated skill registry integration.

lb-953v.title: Add mechanism to clear description in update command

lb-cx9w.title: Clarify agent guidance in lb prime
lb-cx9w.description: Goal: Tighten lb prime so agent sessions do not confuse discovery with ownership or close tasks too early. Context: print_prime_context in src/main.rs emits the AI-facing context used by Codex/Claude hooks; keep it concise because it appears in every session. Requirements: mention that lb ready is discovery only, ownership starts after lb claim succeeds, code should be committed before lb close, and close clears the claim. Acceptance: cargo test passes; lb prime output includes the new guidance in a terse form. Out of scope: adding JSON output or changing claim/sync behavior.

lb-grsl.title: Fix tree view hiding children of filtered-out roots
lb-grsl.description: In --tree mode (main.rs print_tree_item), if a root item is filtered out by should_show (e.g. it's closed and --all isn't set), all its descendants are invisible even if they individually pass the filter. The tree walk starts at roots and skips filtered ones entirely. Fix: when a root is filtered out, still walk its children to see if any pass the filter, promoting them to display as pseudo-roots.

lb-hhip.title: Add cycle detection for parent relationships
lb-hhip.description: set_parent (store.rs:158) prevents self-parenting but not transitive cycles (A parent of B, B parent of A). This would corrupt tree display with infinite recursion in print_tree_item. Add ancestor walk check before accepting a new parent relationship.

lb-kjes.title: Improve Codex agent readiness for Litebrite
lb-kjes.description: Outcome: Codex sessions in Litebrite repos should get both concise tracker context and a reusable brite-authoring skill without the user re-explaining Litebrite workflow. Context: lb setup codex already configures Codex hooks/rules and lb prime already injects session context. Completion: child brites are closed and a fresh/re-run lb setup codex leaves the repo configured while installing the global brite-authoring skill only when missing.

lb-lktz.title: Add cycle detection for blocking dependencies
lb-lktz.description: add_blocking_dep (store.rs:127) checks for self-blocks but not transitive cycles. Creating A blocks B, B blocks C, C blocks A is allowed and causes all three to be permanently blocked by ready_items. Add reachability check before inserting a new blocking dep to prevent cycles.

lb-lztk.title: Warn or cascade on delete of item with children
lb-lztk.description: delete_item (store.rs:82) removes the item and its deps but silently orphans any children (their parent dep is removed since it references the deleted item, making them new roots). Consider either: (a) recursively deleting children, (b) printing a warning listing orphaned children, or (c) requiring --force if children exist.

lb-xsn6.title: Document automatic Codex skill install
lb-xsn6.description: Goal: Document that lb setup codex installs the Litebrite brite-authoring skill automatically. Context: README already describes setup codex writing hooks, config, rules, and lb prime integration. Requirements: add the skill install behavior, destination path, non-overwrite guarantee, and rerun behavior for older repos. Acceptance: README explains what happens on first run and rerun without implying existing user skills are modified. Out of scope: long skill usage tutorial; the skill itself owns the detailed brite-authoring workflow.

lb-yl20.title: Bundle brite-architect Codex skill
lb-yl20.description: Goal: Add a Litebrite-bundled Codex skill that teaches agents to author good brite hierarchies. Context: Skills are directories with SKILL.md and optional agents/openai.yaml; this skill should be general Litebrite work-graph authoring, not mrmouth-specific. Requirements: include trigger metadata for planning/decomposing/creating brites; explain parent-child hierarchy as decomposition, sibling blocks as sequencing, and leaf descriptions as ramp-in handoffs; include a compact leaf description template with goal/context/requirements/acceptance/out-of-scope. Acceptance: the skill files are present in a stable repo path suitable for copying by lb setup codex; content is concise and does not need extra docs. Out of scope: installer logic.
